kb.animals.foot and mouth.prevention: Kubaya mhuka dzose dzinotapukirwa gore roga roga. Kurambidza kufamba kwemhuka, vanhu nemotokari. Chengetedza kuchengeteka kwezvinhu zvipenyu zvakasimba. Taura nyaya dzose dzinoshamisa pakarepo kuDVS.

kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.eating: Mhuka yacho iri kudya nokunwa zvakajairika here?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva: Mumuromo mune kuyerera kwakanyanya here kana kuti kubuda foaming?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread: Dzimwe mhuka dziri muboka dziri kuratidza zviratidzo zvakafanana here?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.high: ZVAKAITIKA NYAYA: Zviratidzo zvakasimba zveKurwara Kwemakumbo Nemuromo. Bvisa mhuka dzose pakarepo. Fonera DVS Emergency line pakarepo. Usafambisa mhuka, motokari kana vanhu pakati pemapurazi. Ichi chirwere chenyika yose chokukurumidzira.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.low: Zviratidzo zvokutanga zvakaonekwa. Bvisa mhuka iyi kubva kune dzimwe mhuka pakarepo senzira yokudzivirira. Ramba uchinyatsocherechedza kwemaawa 24 anotevera. Ongorora dzimwe mhuka dzose kuti uone zviratidzo zvakafanana.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.medium: Kuzvidya mwoyo kwakadzikama. Bvisa mhuka yacho pakarepo. Taura nehofisi yako yeDVS yemunharaunda kana kuti yemhuka mumaawa 24. Usafambisa mhuka kubva papurazi. FMD chirwere chinofanira kuziviswa, unofanira kuzvizivisa zviri pamutemo.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.treatment: Hapana mushonga chaiwo wekurapa FMD. Kurapwa kunobatsira: kuchenesa uye kuuraya maronda, kupa zvokudya zvakapfava nemvura yakachena, kushandisa mishonga inorwisa kuzvimba pasi pokutungamirirwa nemurapi wemhuka, uye kuita kuti mhuka dzigadzikane.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.visual_symptom: Blisters uye maronda pamakumbo, muromo, rurimi uye mazamu. Kunyanya kusvina. Kuora mwoyo.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.when_to_call_v: Fonera chiremba wemhuka kana kuti chiremba wezvokurapa pakarepo. FMD chirwere chinofanira kuziviswa. Usamirira.
kb.animals.goat pox.prevention: Kubayiwa majekiseni pagore. Chengetedza zvipfuwo zvitsva muchitokisi kwevhiki dzinenge nhatu. Dzivisa kusangana nemapoka ane utachiona. Chengetedza dzimba dzakachena uye udzivise vanhu vakawanda.
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing: Mhuka yacho iri kunetseka kufema here kana kuti iri kubuda mumhino?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage.o2: Zvikara zvakaputika kana kuti maronda akavhurika
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals: Pane zvipfuwo zvitsva zvakaunzwa muboka racho munguva pfupi yapfuura here?
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.high: Kuputika kwakakomba kweGoat Pox. Kukurumidzira kubvunzurudzwa kwevana vechipatara kunodiwa. Isa boka rose parutivi. Tanga kubaya mhuka dzisina kubatwa pakarepo. Zivisa zviremera zvemhuka zvemuno.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.low: Zvikanganiso zvenguva yokutanga. Isa mhuka yakakuvara parutivi. Ngwarira dzimwe mbudzi. Iva nechokwadi chokuti dzimba dzakachena uye kuderedza kusagadzikana kwezvipfuwo.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.medium: Chirwere cheGoat Pox. Bvisa mhuka dzose dzakakanganiswa. Taura nemurapi wemhuka kuti uwane mushonga unodzivirira utachiona uye kuti ubhadhare mhuka dzine utano hwakanaka. Disinfect dzimba nemidziyo. Kurambidza kufamba kwemhuka.
kb.animals.goat pox.spreads_by: Kusangana zvakananga, kuyerera kwemhepo, michina yakasvibiswa
kb.animals.goat pox.treatment: Kurapwa kunotsigira chete. Mishonga inorwisa utachiona inogona kunyorwa nachiremba wemhuka. Kuchenesa uye kuuraya utachiona zuva nezuva. Ipa zvokudya zvakanaka uye mvura yakachena. Zvipfuwo zviduku zvinoparadzaniswa nevakuru pavanenge vachiri vana zvinonyanya kushayiwa simba.
kb.animals.goat pox.visual_symptoms: Kukuvara kweganda kwakakwira munzvimbo dzisina bvudzi; mukati memanzwi, muhudyu, mumapfudzi, kumativi emeso nemuromo. Kukuvara kunopfuurira kubva kumativi matsvuku akasimuka kusvika kumapapu kusvika kumapapu ane makapu.
kb.animals.goat pox.when_to_call_vet: Taura nemurapi wemhuka mumaawa 24. Fona pakarepo kana ukava nezvinetso zvekufema kana kuti kukuvara kwacho kwava kutapukirwa zvakanyanya.
kb.animals.healthy.prevention: Ramba uchibayiwa majekiseni nguva dzose, uchibvisa tupukanana, uchirwisa zvidhakwa, uye uchiongororwa nemapurisa egore negore.
kb.animals.healthy.rec.low: Mhuka yako inoratidzika kuva ine utano hwakanaka! Ipa mvura yakachena, zvokudya zvakaenzana, uye kugara uchirwisa zvipembenene (kuparadza zvipembenene, kurapwa kwezvipembenene). Ramba uchifemerwa uye ronga kuongororwa kwezvipfuwo kwemwedzi mitanhatu yega yega.
kb.animals.healthy.visual_symptoms: Hapana zviratidzo zvechirwere zvakaonekwa. Mhuka yacho inoratidzika kuva ine utano hwakanaka.
kb.animals.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Ronga kuongorora kwaunoita nguva dzose mwedzi mitanhatu yoga yoga. Fona pakarepo kana ukaona kuchinja kamwe kamwe mufambiro, kudya, kufamba, kana kuti chitarisiko.

Tanga kudzora zvipembenene zvine utsinye papurazi rose. Kubaya mhuka dzisina kubatwa. Nyora uye tora mifananidzo yezviitiko zvose.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.low: Nodule dzakapfava dzakaonekwa. Isa mhuka yacho yoga uye iongorore zuva nezuva. Shandisa zvinodzvinyirira zvipembenene kumhuka dzose. Ongorora zvimwe zvipfuwo kuti uone kuti pane nodule dzakafanana here. Taura nemurapi wemhuka kana zviratidzo zvikaipisisa mukati memaawa 48.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.medium: Nodules dzakawanda dzine kuchinja kwokuzvibata. Zviparadzanise pakarepo. Tanga kutsigira utano, mishonga inorwisa kuzvimba, kutarisira maronda nokuda nodules yakazaruka, kurwisa nhunzi. Taura nemurapi wako wemhuka mukati maawa 24 kuti uone kana chirwere chacho chiri chirwere uye kuti uwane chirongwa chekurapa.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Kurumwa nezvipembenene (zvipembenene, nhunzi, matanda), kusangana zvakananga
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.treatment: Hapana kurapwa kunorwisa hutachiona. Kutsigira kunosanganisira: mishonga inorwisa kuzvimba, mishonga inorwisa mabhakitiriya kudzivirira zvirwere zvechipiri, kupfeka maronda nokuda kwemapfundo akavhurika, uye kudya kwakanaka. Kudzora zvipembenene kunokosha kudzivirira kupararira.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.visual_symp: Nodules dzokumusoro dzokumusoro dzokumusoro dzokumusoro 2-5 cm mumuviri wose. Nodules dzinogona kuchema mvura. Ma lymph nodes akavhurika anooneka pamutsipa nemakumbo.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.when_to_cal: Taura nemurapi wemhuka mumaawa 24. Fona pakarepo kana mhuka ikarega kudya, ikava nefivha yakanyanya, kana kuti nodules dzikavhurika uye ikabatwa nechirwere chacho.
kb.plants.healthy.prevention: Ramba uchidzora masora, chengetedza mhuka dzinokuvadza vhiki nevhiki, ita kuti mvura isapinda zvakanaka, shandisa marudzi anodzivirira pazvinenge zviripo, uye shandura zvirimwa mwaka nemwaka.
kb.plants.healthy.rec.low: Chirimwa chako chinotaridzika kuva chine utano! Ramba uchitarisira nguva dzose. Iva nechokwadi chekudiridza nguva dzose, kufukidza kwakaringana, kuyerera kwakanaka, uye kudzora masora. Ongorora zviratidzo zvezvipembenene nezvirwere vhiki yoga yoga, uye shandura zvirimwa mwaka woga woga.
kb.plants.healthy.visual_symptoms: Hapana zviratidzo zvechirwere zvakaonekwa. Chirimwa chacho chinoratidzika kuva chine utano, chine ruvara rwakajairika uye kukura kwemashizha.
kb.plants.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Taura nemunhu anoshanda pakurima kana ukaona kuti zvinhu zviri kuoma, zviri kuoma, pane mavara asina kujairika kana kuti pane kukuvara, kana kuti pane mhuka dzinokuvadza.

Nyika yechikomo pamusoro pemitsara kuti ichengetedze matumbo ari kukura kubva kuma spores. Shandisa fungicide yekudzivirira mvura isati yasviba. Kutenderera kwezvirimwa kwemakore matatu nezvibereko zvisiri zve solanaceous.

Shandisa fungicide systemic pakarepo, kana kuoma uye kukohwa mazambiringa mangwanani kuitira kuti spores isasvika mumatumbu. Matumbu anochekwa chete kana mashizha afa uye ivhu raoma zvishoma. kb.plants.potato late blight.spreads_by: Zvikara zvinokonzerwa nemhepo, mvura inoputika, zvirimwa zvine utachiona, zvirimwa zvine utachiona
kb.plants.potato late blight.treatment: Mishonga inouraya fungicides yakafanana ne tomato late blight: metalaxyl, cymoxanil, fenamidone nokuda kwekurapa. Mancozeb uye chlorothalonil nokuda kudzivirira. Nguva dzose shandura mishonga kudzivirira fungicide. Kurapa matumbu akaunganidzwa (kuchengetwa kwakaoma, kunofambiswa zvakanaka) usati wachengetwa kwenguva refu kuitira kuderedza kupararira kwokuora.

kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.we: Mamiriro okunze anga akaita sei panguva yokuzadza uye yokukura kwezviyo?
Kuumbwa kwezviyo kwakakomba. Kukohwa pakarepo pasinei nokuti nguva yacho yakakura zvakadini. Zviyo zvakagadzirwa zvakasimba hazvifaniri kushandiswa pakudya kwevanhu kana kuti zvokudya zvemhuka nemhaka yezvokudya zvinonzi mycotoxins. Taura nekukura kwekurima kuti uwane mazano ekubvisa zviyo. Tsvaga mhando dzisingabvi muforoma dzemwaka unotevera.

Zviratidzo zvekutanga zveforoma zvakaonekwa. Kana nguva yokukohwa yava pedyo, kukohwa kwokutanga kuitira kudzivirira kupararira. Iva nechokwadi chokuti mhepo inoyerera zvakanaka pedyo nemisoro yezviyo. Shandisa fungicide kana zvirimwa zvichiri mavhiki kubva pakukohwa uye mamiriro acho achiri kunyorova.

Kuumbwa kwezviyo zvine mwero. Kukohwa nokukurumidza sezvinobvira  usamirira. Zviyo zvakachekwa zvakaoma pakarepo kusvika pasi pe13% hunyoro. Paradzanisa zviyo zvine muforoma nezviyo zvine utano. Usadyisa mhuka zviyo zvakanyatsogadzirwa sezvo mycotoxins inogona kukuvadza.

kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.trea: Mushure mokugadzirwa kwechimedu chezviyo, fungicide ine simba shoma. Kushandiswa kwekudzivirira fungicide panguva yekuputika (semuenzaniso propiconazole) kunonyanya kushanda. Kukohwa kunotanga mumwaka unonaya. Chengetedza zviyo pazasi pe13% hunyoro kuitira kudzivirira chakuvhuvhu mushure mekukohwa.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.visu: Ruvara rwepepuru, tsvuku, grey kana nhema pamisoro yezviyo. Mbeu dzezviyo dzakatsemuka kana kuti dzakatsauka ruvara. Kukura kwezvipembenene zvakachena kana zveguruva kunooneka pakati petsanga dzezviyo.

kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.lo: Zviratidzo zvekutanga zvehutachiona hwepa mosaic pane zvirimwa zvishomanana. Bvisa uye kuparadza mashizha akakanganiswa. Shandisa mishonga yekuuraya zvipembenene kudzora aphid vectors. Usashanda pamiti ine utano pashure pokubata iyo yakakuvadzwa usina kugeza maoko ako. Ongorora zvimwe zvirimwa zuva nezuva.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.me: Kupararira kwehutachiona hwe mosaic kwakadzikama. Bvisa zvirimwa zvose zvine utachiona uye zviparadze kunze kwemunda. Dzvanya zvirimwa zvakasara nemishonga inorayirwa yekudzivirira zvipembenene. Usadzorera zvirimwa zvecucurbits munzvimbo ino mwaka uno. Funga nezvemachira anotsinhira kuti udzivise ma aphids.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.spread: Zvipembenene zveAphid, zvirimwa zvine utachiona, zvishandiso zvekubvisa
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.treatm: Hapana mushonga wezvirwere zvehutachiona.
